Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 계속 훈련해야 되는지 묻는다. 뭐라고 얘기할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> is asking if she should keep training. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>がトレーニングを続けるべきか尋ねる。何と声をかけようか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>询问是否要继续训练。该说什么好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>詢問是否要繼續訓練。該說什麼好呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> demande si elle doit continuer l'entraînement. Que dois-je dire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> fragt, ob weiter trainiert werden soll. Was soll ich antworten?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> pregunta si debe seguir entrenando. ¿Qué le digo?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> pergunta se deve continuar a treinar. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ถามว่าต้องฝึกต่อไหม จะบอกว่าอะไรดีคะ?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bertanya apakah dia harus terus berlatih. Apa yang harus kukatakan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hỏi có nên tiếp tục huấn luyện không. Mình nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> पूछ रही है कि क्या उसे ट्रेनिंग जारी रखनी चाहिए। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 今日はここで終わりにしようか？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Sollen wir es für heute gut sein lassen?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: วันนี้พอแค่นี้ก่อนดีกว่าไหม?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Mari kita sudahi untuk hari ini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Hôm nay dừng ở đây thôi nhé?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: आज के लिए बस इतना ही करते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Let's try something different this time.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 別のトレーニングで代えよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Essayons quelque chose de différent cette fois.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Lass uns diesmal etwas anderes versuchen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Vamos tentar algo diferente desta vez.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ลองฝึกอย่างอื่นแทนดีกว่า
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Mari kita coba sesuatu yang berbeda kali ini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Lần này chúng ta thử huấn luyện khác nhé.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: इस बार कुछ अलग ट्रेनिंग करते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ยื่นโพชั่นเพิ่มพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đã đưa một bình Dược Hoạt Lực.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat das Training beendet und beschlossen, sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió dejar de entrenar y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu descansar depois de terminar o treino.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk berhenti berlatih dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định dừng huấn luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने ट्रेनिंग रोककर आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours sur sa faim.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl eine Pause eingelegt wurde, scheint <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> etwas enttäuscht zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Decidiu descansar, mas parece que <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> queria continuar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจอยู่
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih tampak tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, nhưng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat das Training erneut in Angriff genommen und war erfolgreich.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y obtuvo buenos resultados.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou o treino novamente e obteve bons resultados.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ลองฝึกอีกครั้งและได้ผลลัพธ์ที่ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi dan mencapai hasil yang memuaskan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử thách huấn luyện lại và đạt được kết quả tốt.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर कोशिश की और अच्छे नतीजे हासिल किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat das Training erneut in Angriff genommen, ist jedoch gescheitert.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero volvió a fallar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou o treino novamente, mas falhou.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ลองฝึกอีกครั้งแต่ก็ล้มเหลวอีก
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử thách huấn luyện lại nhưng lại thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est illuminée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat den Trank erhalten und sich darüber gefreut.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó tras recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ficou feliz por receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>สดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गई।
